content:
PowerPoint files are the worst thing to share. They look different on every device, fonts break, animations glitch, and the file size is ridiculous. PDF fixes all of that — but you need a fast, private way to convert.

## Why PDF Beats PPTX for Sharing

You spend hours on a presentation. Every slide perfectly aligned, the right images, consistent typography. Then you email the PPTX, and it's a mess on the recipient's screen. Different Office version? Layout broken. Different fonts installed? Text shifted. Opening on a phone? Good luck.

PDF preserves your work exactly as designed. Everyone sees the same thing — Windows, Mac, phone, tablet. No surprises.

## The Free Way to Convert

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) handles PPTX-to-PDF conversion directly in your browser. No software to install, no uploads to a server. Your presentation stays on your device the whole time.

Just drag your PowerPoint file into the converter, pick PDF as output, and download. Takes about ten seconds for a standard 20-slide deck.

What you keep: all slide content, images, charts, SmartArt, embedded fonts (in most cases). What changes: animations become static (they can't animate in PDF), transitions disappear. That's actually a bonus for sharing.

## Beyond Presentations

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) handles more than PowerPoint. Convert Word docs, Excel sheets, images, and ebooks — all the same way: local, private, free. It's the Swiss Army knife of online file tools.

Designers working with presentations might also find [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io) useful for client mood boards, or [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) for adding voiceovers to presentation videos.

## When to Convert

- Before emailing a presentation to a client
- Before uploading to a portfolio or website
- When you need to print handouts
- For archiving old presentations (PDF takes less space)
- When the recipient doesn't have PowerPoint

## Bottom Line

Converting PowerPoint to PDF shouldn't cost money or compromise your privacy. [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) solves it in one click. Stop sending broken PPTX files.
